Five permit/building records were saved for 17404 W Stagg St (APN 2202-004-010) from the PRISM permit-history search:

1. 06044-90000-07649: mechanical permit (HVAC), dated 2006-07-21, status ISSUED. A downloadable document is available.
2. 1979VN05830: building permit for new construction, dated 1979-11-30, status not supplied.
3. 1970VN58829: building permit for a building addition, dated 1970-06-10, status not supplied. It appears twice, as record IDs 8316367 and 8316368.
4. 1950VN07525: building permit for a new building, dated 1950-04-20, status not supplied.

No. An issued permit does not prove final approval. The saved permit research says so directly, and it also says that missing records do not prove there are no permits or violations.

The only record with a stated status is the 2006 HVAC permit, and that status is ISSUED, not finaled. The four building-permit records have no status at all. None of the saved evidence includes final inspection or certificate-of-occupancy information, so the evidence cannot establish final approval for any of these permits.

The saved next step is to check the permit scope and final inspection records for the existing buildings and any proposed alterations.
